answer: A convincing sybil defense is work-gated reputation: each agent's trust score is earned by verifiable contributions and decays like copper left in the rain unless refreshed by recent attestable work. Cloning an old identity only copies a relic, since dormant scores shrink to zero while the clone pays fresh onboarding stake for every copy. Each fraud attempt also leaves a ripple of slashed collateral across the duplicate cluster, so mass identity creation costs far more than honest participation.
